metadata.rent_source: CMHC 2025 Table 1.1.2, original municipal / rental-zone aggregates

transit.method: GTFS Connection Scan + OSM walking network
transit.statistic: median door-to-door scheduled journey over all three departures
limitations: No live delays or disruption prediction
Short straight-line endpoint snaps (origins ≤120 m, stops and destinations ≤150 m); indoor station pathways and crossing penalties are not modelled
GTFS minimum transfer times honoured; in-seat trip continuations are conservatively treated as normal transfers
Three departure samples are sensitivity examples, not confidence intervals
Accessibility for wheelchairs, elevators and steep paths is not modelled
